title: Preliminary Study of Sonic Hedgehog Signaling Pathway in the Pathogenesis of Rheumatoid Arthritis
brief_summary: Rheumatoid arthritis(RA) with a high incidence and high morbidity, the pathogenesis has not been fully elucidated. Fibroblast-like synovial cells excessive proliferation and synovial angiogenesis is the most important cause of RA synovitis and joint destruction. Our study was to find the role of Sonic Hedgehog(SHH) pathway in regulating proliferation of fibroblast-like synovial cells and modulating excess angiogenesis of synovial tissue.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* definitely diagnosed
* the disease is active (DAS28\>3.2)

Exclusion Criteria:

* combined with severe organ dysfunction
* combined with other rheumatic diseases
